apps.name: uTube
apps.subtitle: Native YouTube viewing and commenting
apps.localizedDescription: A personal YouTube client with inline comments and replies, a YouTube inbox, Wall and Carousel Home layouts, AirPlay, background playback, downloads, and customizable controls. Light mode by default. Installs alongside Opaline as its own app; existing Opaline settings and sign-in do not transfer. Maintained by kharrison, based on Opaline by verback2308. For AltStore Classic.

versions.localizedDescription:
uTube by kharrison, based on Opaline by verback2308.

- Added three more experimental playback methods after the previous six: Mobile web · native HLS, Embedded web · native HLS, and TV compatibility · byte ranges.
- Mobile and embedded HLS use the standard native player with automatic quality. The embedded route stays anonymous and requires an embeddable video with a usable playlist.
- TV compatibility uses the YouTube account already connected for comments and notifications. It tries compatible separate video/audio streams with the existing solver and native delivery. No new Google project or account setup is required when that account is connected.
- New methods are off by default. Enable them in Settings → Debug → Playback sources. Your existing order, enabled choices, and working solver are preserved.
- Improved embedded request configuration and added regression checks for delivery selection, account requirements and settings migration.

All five experimental alternatives depend on the video and session. Live playback and sustained AirPlay still need device testing; these are not guaranteed fixes for YouTube restrictions. The original four methods remain the defaults. See EXPERIMENTAL_PLAYBACK.md for the comparison and test guide.

uTube by kharrison, based on Opaline by verback2308.

- Added two experimental playback options after the existing four: Web · native HLS and Embedded web · byte ranges. Enable them in Settings → Debug → Playback sources. Both are off by default; your existing choices and solver stay configured as before.
- Native web HLS can use the YouTube website account you already connected, with automatic quality in the standard player. No separate Google registration or web player window is needed. Availability depends on the video and session.
- Embedded playback tries anonymous compatible streams for videos that allow embedding, using the existing signature solver and native HLS delivery with quality selection.
- HLS manifest links also support throttling challenges embedded in their URL path, using the existing solver.
- Added time limits for experimental loading and guards against late, duplicate or cancelled source responses replacing the current video.

These are experimental alternatives, not guaranteed fixes for YouTube restrictions. Live playback and sustained AirPlay on the new methods still need device testing. The current four playback methods remain the defaults. See EXPERIMENTAL_PLAYBACK.md in the repository for details and the test guide.

uTube by kharrison, based on Opaline by verback2308.

- Replies now filters comment notifications from the working YouTube inbox, with support for wrapped comment links and older inbox pages.
- Tap a comment notification to read its parent and replies inside the notification panel. The linked comment is highlighted; you can load more replies and send a reply without opening or changing the playing video.
- Replying to someone inside a thread addresses that person. Drafts are kept separately for each recipient while replies stay in the correct thread.
- Removed the old app-release news setting and stopped release-news polling. Credits remain in Settings; exported debug logs now use the uTube name.
- The casting button stays red whether connected or disconnected.
- Carousel cards fill more of the available height. Swipe left or right between cards, or pull down to refresh; upward vertical scrolling is disabled.

This update keeps uTube's separate app identity and the existing playback and solver configuration. Carousel previews still yield to a playing or minimized video and to AirPlay.

uTube by kharrison, based on Opaline by verback2308.

- uTube now installs as its own app alongside Opaline, using the separate com.kharrison.utube app identifier.
- The Open in uTube share action uses its own link handler so it opens uTube when both apps are installed.
- The kharrison Apps source now offers the standalone uTube build. Older builds that shared Opaline's identity are no longer offered in the source.
- Refreshed the GitHub page with uTube's features, icon, installation instructions, and credits. Removed upstream promotional and donation buttons.
- Jailbreak packages also use their own package ID and app folder.

Install uTube from the refreshed kharrison Apps source as a new app. You can keep Opaline or the older uTube installation. Settings, downloads, and sign-in from the older installation do not transfer automatically; connect your account in the new app. Future uTube updates use this new identity.

Wall, Carousel, inline comments, YouTube notifications, customizable controls, and AirPlay behavior remain available.

apps.name: The Last Dragonrider
apps.subtitle: A dragon-riding pixel RPG
apps.localizedDescription: Explore Emberfell with Corin and his dragon in this pixel-art adventure. The game is included in the app for offline single-player play, with persistent saves on your device. Existing Google cloud saves and story co-op are available online through the game's sign-in flow. Browser-local saves do not transfer automatically. For AltStore Classic on iPhone and iPad running iOS 15 or newer.

versions.localizedDescription:
The Last Dragonrider 1.0.1 by kharrison.

- New Corin and Aurelius silhouette icon, using the exact raised-wing pose from the game’s title screen.
- Matching artwork on your Home Screen and in AltStore.
- Offline single-player and device saves remain available.
- Full-screen native app, with bundled art, music and controls.
- Browser handoff for the existing Google account; cloud saves and story co-op require internet.

Existing browser-local saves are separate. Sync them with your Google account before moving to the app. Native Google sign-in and co-op still require confirmation on your device. Updating preserves app saves; removing the app removes device-only saves.

apps.name: Verse
apps.subtitle: Your next song starts here
apps.localizedDescription: An offline lyric notebook for iPhone and iPad. Organize songs into notebooks, search titles and lyrics, add tags and favorites, and write with native spell check. Find perfect and near rhymes from a bundled English pronunciation dictionary with syllable filters. Connect a folder in iCloud Drive through Files on each device for cloud sync while Verse is open. Parallel edits remain separate drafts. Includes text sharing, complete backups, and recoverable deleted lyrics. iOS 16 or newer. For AltStore Classic.

versions.localizedDescription:
Verse 1.0.1 by kharrison

- A dedicated native lyric notebook for iPhone and iPad, installable through AltStore Classic.
- Notebooks, lyric search, tags, favorites, word and line counts, and quick Verse/Chorus/Bridge headings.
- Native spell check with suggestions and a personal dictionary. Optional autocorrect starts off.
- Offline perfect and near rhymes from the CMU Pronouncing Dictionary, with syllable filters. Select a word in your lyric and tap Rhyme.
- Local autosave and cloud-folder sync through Files. Choose the same iCloud Drive folder in Settings on each device. Sync runs while the app is open; Files handles provider upload/download.
- Immutable saved revisions preserve concurrent edits as separate drafts. Recover lyrics from Recently deleted, share plain text, and export or restore complete backups.

Cloud setup requires choosing a folder in iCloud Drive, not On My iPhone. iCloud propagation and AltStore installation still require confirmation on physical devices. The app does not require a custom CloudKit entitlement or a rhyme API subscription.

Verse now has its own GitHub repository: https://github.com/kharrisongit/Verse

apps.name: Quill
apps.subtitle: A quiet place for your next novel
apps.localizedDescription: Write and organize novels on iPhone and iPad. A focused formatted chapter editor, outline, character and place notes, word goals, spell check, saved revisions, and recoverable trash. Export Word documents, EPUB ebooks, formatted HTML, plain text, or print. Local autosave works offline. Connect a folder in iCloud Drive for optional sync while the app is open. Companion browser app: https://kharrisongit.github.io/Quill/. Desktop Chrome and Edge support shared-folder sync; other browsers can import and export backups. iOS 16 or later. Install with AltStore Classic.

versions.localizedDescription:
Quill 1.0.3 — simpler chapter controls.

- Delete chapter is available only in the ⓘ chapter-details menu.
- Removed chapter-delete buttons from the chapter list and desktop sidebar.
- Deletion still asks for confirmation and remains recoverable in Recently deleted.

Quill — your story starts here.

- A dedicated novel-writing app for iPhone and iPad, with a matching GitHub Pages browser edition.
- Books, chapter outlines and reordering, formatted prose, scene breaks, focus mode, native/browser spell check, and dark appearance.
- Character, place, idea, and research notes; chapter synopses and writing status; manuscript and session word goals.
- Local autosave, immutable saved revisions, parallel-draft review, and recoverable trash.
- Word (.docx), EPUB, formatted HTML, plain text, print/PDF, and complete JSON backups.
- Optional shared-folder sync. Choose the same iCloud Drive folder in the iPhone app and desktop Chrome/Edge. Other browsers use backup import/export. Files handles cloud delivery; sync runs while the app is open.

iOS 16+. Install Quill.ipa through AltStore Classic. Physical-device installation and iCloud delivery still need verification on your devices.

Web app: https://kharrisongit.github.io/Quill/
Source: https://github.com/kharrisongit/Quill

Quill 1.0.2 — easier chapter deletion.

- The ⓘ button now opens a chapter-details dialog with a clearly labeled Delete chapter button.
- Each chapter in the chapter list has a trash button. Deletion asks for confirmation and remains recoverable in Recently deleted.
- Chapter status and synopsis can be edited in the dialog, with explicit Save details and Cancel controls.
